ideas.title: Escape the Giant Vacuum 🧹
ideas.hook: You are crumb-sized in a giant's house. Run out of your mousehole, grab crumbs and lost coins off the floor, and get back before the giant robot vacuum sweeps the room.
core_loop: Leave the mousehole into a giant room
Grab crumbs, coins and lost items (each one makes you slower)
The vacuum switches on and sweeps toward you; race home to bank your haul
Spend on speed and pockets, unlock bigger rooms (kitchen, garage, attic)
ideas.twist: The vacuum pulls you backwards, so you can drop loot mid-run to break free. Greed versus speed on every trip.
retention: New room every week as a limited event
Daily 'boss vacuum' run with bonus loot
ideas.why_now: Escape / run jumped 0.70 this week to 1.25 momentum ([🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 40.5K CCU, +1 Spider Arm🕷️ 16.9K), and Giant / huge rose 0.75 to 1.63 (Raise The Biggest Family 21.8K, Durian Garden 🍈 15.2K). Interior maps are at 1.88.
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
[🎃] Eat Everything In A Grocery Store
ideas.differentiator: Most giant games make you the giant. Here you are tiny, the giant house is the hazard, and every pickup slows your escape.

ideas.title: Outrun the Supernova ☄️
ideas.hook: Run laps around tiny round planets while a supernova shockwave chases you. Every lap gives +1 speed; get fast enough and you launch to the next planet before the wave hits.
core_loop: Run around a small planet ahead of the shockwave
Each lap adds +1 speed
Hit the launch pad once you pass the speed gate to hop to the next planet
Collect star shards for trails, then rebirth into a new galaxy
ideas.twist: The planets are round, so a fast runner can lap the shockwave from behind and grab a speed bonus for catching it.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula is at 2.40, up 0.43 this week, and +1 stat per action at 2.26 (+0.41) with +1 Slinky Escape (5.4K) and +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (16.9K). Space rose 0.59 to 1.65 (roll the world 🌎 6.2K) and Escape / run gained 0.70.
ideas.differentiator: +1 speed escapes run in a straight line. Round planets turn the chase into a loop and planet-hopping becomes the progression.

ideas.title: Slingshot for Cash 💸
ideas.hook: Load your ragdoll into a giant slingshot and fire it through a bank. Cash sticks to whatever body part hits it, so the wilder you tumble, the more you grab.
core_loop: Pull back and aim the slingshot
Fly and bounce through rooms of cash stacks, safes and gold bars
Everything stuck to you banks when you land
Upgrade slingshot power and sticky suits to reach deeper vaults
ideas.twist: Laser alarms knock cash off you, so you choose between a clean aimed shot and a chaotic tumble through more money.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch climbed 0.50 this week to 2.38 ([🎃] Throw Food For Animals 104.9K CCU, Ragdoll Reality 🩸 34.8K) and Physics Sim rose 0.60 to 2.20 ([🎃] Realistic Ragdoll Engine 🩸 25.2K). Money / rich is at 2.04.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll sandboxes have no economy and launch games throw objects. Here you are the projectile and your crash path is your loot.

ideas.title: Sell Shoes to Giants 👟
ideas.hook: Run a cobbler shop at the foot of a giants' village. Giants stomp in with ruined boots; stitch, glue and polish shoes bigger than your house, then send them back for giant tips.
core_loop: Take a giant's order at the shop window
Climb the shoe and fix it: stitch holes, glue the sole, polish
Hand it back and collect the tip
Expand the shop with cranes, sewing machines and NPC workers
ideas.twist: Each giant has a mood. Rush a job and they stomp in anger, shaking the shop and knocking your tools around.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.80 (down 0.26 but still high confidence: 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 36.5K CCU, 🧸 My Small Business 29.5K). Giant / huge jumped 0.75 to 1.63 (Raise The Biggest Family 21.8K).
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell normal-sized goods. Here each order is a climbable giant object, so the work itself is a mini obby.

ideas.title: Rent Scooters for Cash 🛴
ideas.hook: Run an e-scooter rental across a city. Place docks at hotspots, earn fares from riders, and ride out yourself to rescue scooters dumped on rooftops, in rivers and down alleys.
core_loop: Buy scooters and place docks around the city
NPC riders rent and pay per minute
Track and ride back abandoned scooters before their battery dies
Upgrade batteries, docks and fleet size to unlock new districts
ideas.twist: Rival players run fleets on the same server and compete for the best hotspots during rush hour.
ideas.why_now: Vehicle Sim is at 1.56 ([🎃] Bike Universe 33.4K CCU, [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing] 26.6K) and Vehicles at 1.52. Realistic art is rising at 1.73 and Sell / run a shop holds 1.80 (🧸 My Small Business 29.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Scooter games are about riding. Here you own the fleet, and riding is how you recover it and grow the business.

ideas.title: +1 Reach Per Save ⚽
ideas.hook: Be a ragdoll goalkeeper. Every shot you block gives +1 arm reach, until your stretchy arms cover the whole goal and the shooters switch to fireballs, rockets and buses.
core_loop: Dive to block shots
Each save adds +1 arm reach
Shooter waves escalate from balls to fireballs to cars
Rebirth for wider goals and new stadiums
ideas.twist: Long arms flop with ragdoll physics, so more reach also means wilder dives. Buy grip upgrades to control them.
retention: Longest-arms leaderboard; friends can play the shooter
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula is at 2.40 (+0.43) with +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (16.9K CCU) already selling stretchy arms, and Hit / swing / launch rose 0.50 to 2.38. Soccer hit games like Illegal Soccer pull 32.5K.
ideas.differentiator: Soccer games are about scoring. This flips you into the keeper, and your growing arms are the stat players watch climb.

ideas.title: Zamboni Art 🧊
ideas.hook: Drive a zamboni across frozen lakes to carve giant pictures into the ice. A blimp crowd overhead rates each drawing and pays you; better machines carve thicker, glowing lines.
core_loop: Get a prompt (a fish, a heart, a rocket)
Drive the zamboni to carve the shape
The blimp crowd rates it from above and pays out
Upgrade blades, ice colours and unlock bigger lakes
ideas.twist: Thin ice cracks if you cross your own line too often, so every picture is a one-line route puzzle.
retention: New lakes, ending with a lava lake
ideas.why_now: Paint / create holds 2.13 with high confidence, led by vehicle-creation games (Backseat Rally 26.8K CCU, [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing] 26.6K, Paint and Hide! 🎨 14.0K). Paint / create × Ice / fire is an open gap (score 4.67) and Ice / fire sits at 1.37.
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games use a cursor. Here the vehicle is the pen, so driving skill and drawing skill are the same thing.

ideas.title: Draw Your Ride 🚗
ideas.hook: Draw any vehicle shape with your mouse, from wheels and body to wings, and it spawns as a physics car. Race it down crazy hills and see if your doodle survives.
core_loop: Draw a vehicle with limited ink
It spawns as a physics car at the top of the hill
Distance and finish time pay out
Unlock ink types, longer ink and harder courses
ideas.twist: Ink changes physics: rubber ink bounces, metal ink is heavy and smashes walls, rocket ink thrusts.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 2.13 and Physics Sim rose 0.60 this week to 2.20 (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 34.8K CCU, Crazy Diver 12.9K). Crash games like Realistic Car Destruction (12.3K) show vehicle chaos is pulling players.
ideas.differentiator: Car games give you cars to buy. Here you invent the car, so every crash is a funny one-off.

ideas.title: Mush Huskies for Gold 🛷
ideas.hook: Raise a team of sled dogs, hitch them up and race across frozen trails for gold. Every husky has its own speed, stamina and personality, and you breed toward the perfect team.
core_loop: Adopt and train pups
Pick a team order and hitch them to your sled
Race trails against other players for gold
Buy better sleds and breed rarer dogs for the index
ideas.twist: Team order matters: put a lazy dog up front and the team tangles mid-race.
ideas.why_now: The "___ for ___" formula is still the top title pattern at 2.78, though it cooled 0.59 this week ([🎃] Bike For Egg! 31.7K CCU, Hike For Eggs 7.9K). Race / drive is steady at 1.13 and Vehicle Sim at 1.56 ([🎃] Bike Universe 33.4K).
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Pet games stop at collecting and racing games use machines. Here the pets are the engine, and team building decides the race.

ideas.title: Build a Ship in a Bottle 🍾
ideas.hook: Use tweezers to build tiny pirate ships inside glass bottles. Every finished bottle goes on your shop shelf, and rare ships sell to collectors for a fortune.
core_loop: Pick a bottle and a ship kit
Slide masts, sails and cannons through the neck with tweezers
Pull the string to raise the sails, then shelve it
Sell to collectors and unlock bigger bottles, up to whole islands
ideas.twist: A storm event shakes the shop, and ships with sloppy glue collapse inside their bottles.
retention: Friends can visit and like your shelf
ideas.why_now: Paint / create holds 2.13 and Sell / run a shop 1.80 (🧸 My Small Business 29.5K CCU). Tactile craft-and-sell newcomers like Make Rugs! and Dressmaker's Dream show the same cozy hands-on style, and interior maps sit at 1.88.
ideas.differentiator: Craft games make normal-sized goods. This is a precision build in a tiny space, with a big collector payoff.
